observation.summary: When housing/infrastructure headroom is zero, the birth accumulator keeps fractional pressure, so reopening one bed can immediately realize a birth that was accumulated while births were structurally impossible.

evidence.statement: birthCarry is retained after births are clamped by headroom, including headroom=0.

hypothesis.cause: Birth accumulation is independent of whether the village has any demographic headroom.
hypothesis.prediction: Resetting birth carry while headroom is zero prevents blocked years from preloading an immediate birth, while healthy headroom still accumulates fractional births.
hypothesis.falsifier: Healthy-headroom accumulation stops or zero-headroom snapshots still retain carry.

candidates.reason: Keeps existing rates and only closes accumulation during structurally impossible birth years.
Would rebalance healthy villages without evidence that the rate itself is wrong.

implementation.summary: Clear fractional birth carry only while demographic headroom is zero.

before.summary: zero headroom can retain birthCarry near 1.
